ruled_out_vectors.vector: C1: Core->PoolType trust — pool type returns amountOut > actual tokens moved
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: _safeDecrementUint128 reverts if amountOut > reserve (AMMModule.sol:3503-3528). actualAmountIn > originalAmountIn check at line 1405. _validateProtocolFees at lines 1654-1677 ensures totalFees <= amountIn.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C2: Core->Handler mismatch — handler receives mismatched token pair
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Handler validates msg.sender == AMM. Core resolves tokenIn/tokenOut from poolId via PoolDecoder, passes to handler. Handler cannot override tokens. Balance delta check at line 2208 ensures exact amount delivered.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C3: Core->Hook fee manipulation — hook returns fee > swap amount
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: _applySwapByInputInputFees at line 2616: if (feeAmount > swapAmountIn) revert LBAMM__InsufficientInputForFees(). Hook fee cannot exceed amountIn.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C4: Hook->Registry settings change between beforeSwap and afterSwap
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: AMMStandardHook._getOrFetchTokenSettings caches at storage mapping level (_tokenSettings[token]). Settings persist across beforeSwap/afterSwap within same tx. registryUpdateTokenSettings requires _requireCallerIsRegistry which is admin-only. Reentrancy guard prevents re-entry during swap.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C5: PoolType->Core return — pool returns feeAmount > amountIn
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: _validateProtocolFees (AMMModule.sol:1654-1677) checks totalFees > amountIn and reverts with LBAMM__FeeAmountExceedsInputAmount.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C6: Handler->External reentrancy via token callback
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Double protection: AMM uses transient reentrancy guard (ENTERED flag stays set during entire operation). CLOBTransferHandler has nonReentrant modifier on all public entry points. Token callbacks cannot reenter AMM or handler.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C7: INV-H01 — external calls to hook functions
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: All state-changing hook functions (beforeSwap, afterSwap, validateAddLiquidity, validatePoolCreation) check _requireCallerIsAMM() which reverts if msg.sender != AMM (immutable). validateHandlerOrder is view-only.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C8: INV-H02 — settlement conservation
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Balance delta check at AMMModule.sol:2208: if (balanceInBefore + swapCache.amountIn != balanceInAfter) revert. Handler must deliver exact amountIn. Short or over delivery both cause revert.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C9: INV-H04 — hook fee cap and overflow in _executeQueuedHookFeesByHookTransfers
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Hook fees calculated via FullMath.mulDiv(amount, feeBPS, MAX_BPS). feeBPS is uint16, max 10000 (100%). Combined fees checked in _applySwapByInputInputFees: feeAmount > swapAmountIn reverts. Overflow in protocolFeeFromHookFees checked explicitly at line 2638.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C10: INV-SW04 — output exceeds reserves for each pool type
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Core updates reserves via _safeDecrementUint128(reserve, amountOut) which reverts if amountOut > reserve. Applies to all pool types (Dynamic, Fixed, SingleProvider) since Core handles reserve accounting.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C11: INV-S04 — fee denomination consistency across fee paths
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Traced all fee paths: tokenInTokenInFee and tokenOutTokenInFee deducted from amountIn (tokenIn denomination). tokenInTokenOutFee and tokenOutTokenOutFee deducted from amountOut (tokenOut denomination). Protocol fees always in tokenIn. No denomination mismatch. Call graph confirms consistent denomination.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C12: INV-E03 — sandwich resistance via limitAmount
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Victim's swap has limitAmount in SwapOrder. _finalizeSwapCollectFundsAndDisburse checks: if (swapCache.amountOut < swapOrder.limitAmount) revert LBAMM__LimitAmountNotMet(). Sandwich attacker moves price, but victim's output floor protects them.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C13: PoolDecoder edge cases — pool type address constraint
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Pool type address must have 6 leading zero bytes (fit in 112 bits). PoolDecoder.getPoolType extracts via shr(POOL_ID_TYPE_ADDRESS_SHIFT, poolId). Address > 2^112 would be truncated. createPool validates pool type address at registration.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C14: createPool with edge parameters (zero tick spacing, max fee, extreme sqrtPrice)
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Pool type validates parameters at creation. DynamicPoolType enforces tickSpacing > 0. Fee is uint16 capped at MAX_BPS. sqrtPrice at extremes is valid. Pool type address constraint (6 leading zero bytes) enforced by PoolDecoder encoding.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C15: Storage slot collisions across diamond facets
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: All modules (AMMModule, ModuleAdmin, ModuleFeeCollection, ModuleLiquidity) use LBAMMStorage at fixed slot 0x9A1D via Storage.appStorage(). Zero own storage slots. Verified via Slither get_storage_layout. External contracts (AMMStandardHook, CLOBTransferHandler) have their own storage, no collision with diamond.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C16: _validatePricingBounds path coverage (Halmos)
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Halmos symbolic execution: check_C16_pricingBounds_allPaths (12 paths) and check_C16_zeroPrice_maxBypass (3 paths) both passed. All paths enforce bounds when set. Zero-price bypass in validateHandlerOrder confirmed (CP-003, view-only, Low severity).

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C17: Medusa fuzz on AMMStandardHook
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Medusa fuzzer: 19 assertion tests passed, 0 failed, ~147K calls. No invariant violations found.
ruled_out_vectors.test_file: not-applicable: Medusa built-in assertions on AMMStandardHook, no separate test file

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C18: Medusa fuzz on SingleProviderPoolType
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Medusa fuzzer: 11 assertion tests passed, 0 failed, ~284K calls. No invariant violations found.
ruled_out_vectors.test_file: not-applicable: Medusa built-in assertions on SingleProviderPoolType, no separate test file

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C19: Bunni hook/pool accounting desync — afterSwap revert leaves beforeSwap state
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: AMMModule._executeSwapHook propagates hook reverts: if iszero(success) { revert }. If afterSwap reverts, entire swap tx reverts. No partial state persistence. AMMStandardHook.beforeSwap only writes transient storage and reads from cache — no persistent state changes that could desync.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C20: Diamond selector collision across facets and pool types
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Extracted all 4-byte selectors via Slither list_functions across AMMModule, ModuleAdmin, ModuleFeeCollection, ModuleLiquidity, pool types. No collisions. Pool types are external contracts called via ILimitBreakAMMPoolType interface, NOT diamond facets — they cannot inject selectors.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C21: Transient storage cross-path — addLiquidity/removeLiquidity/collectFees reading swap slot
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: DIRECT_SWAP_BEFORE_SWAP_AMOUNT_SLOT (0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF) is only written in beforeSwap path and only read in afterSwap path within _validatePricingBounds. validateAddLiquidity, validateRemoveLiquidity, validatePoolCreation do NOT access this slot. No cross-operation confusion. Known intra-swap stale read is CP-001 (Low).

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C22: Hook return value manipulation (Uni V4 vectors) — inflated fee from beforeSwap
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: _executeSwapHook reads hook return as raw uint256 feeAmount. But _applySwapByInputInputFees validates: if (feeAmount > swapAmountIn) revert LBAMM__InsufficientInputForFees(). For output fees: similar check against amountOut. Hook cannot inflate fees beyond swap amount.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: H1: Pool type returns amountOut > actual tokens moved — Core credits user more than received
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Reserve decrement via _safeDecrementUint128 prevents amountOut > reserve. safeTransfer of amountOut from AMM fails if AMM doesn't hold enough. Double guard.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: H2: Handler swaps different token pair than pool's configured pair
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Core resolves tokenIn/tokenOut from poolId and passes to handler. Handler receives but cannot override token addresses. Core controls the pair.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: H3: Hook fee callback returns manipulated fee — Core distributes non-existent tokens
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Hook fee validated: if (feeAmount > swapAmountIn) revert. Fee is deducted FROM swap amount, not added. Cannot extract more than swap amount.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: H4: Direct swap bypasses beforeSwap pricing check — afterSwap reads stale transient slot
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Known issue CP-001/HOOK-001. Low severity. Requires beforeSwap flag disabled + afterSwap enabled. Stale price check only, not direct value extraction. Within single swap, transient storage is written in beforeSwap and read in afterSwap correctly.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: H5: Pool type addLiquidity return value doesn't match actual token requirement
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Core checks actual balances after user transfers tokens. _safeIncrementUint128 for reserve update reverts on overflow. Balance check ensures amount0Used/amount1Used match actual transfers.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: H6: Two pool types sharing same pool ID (hash collision)
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: PoolDecoder encodes pool type address into poolId. Different pool type addresses produce different poolIds even with same token pair and params. No hash — deterministic encoding.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: H7: Registry settings updated between beforeSwap and afterSwap
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Settings cached in _tokenSettings mapping. Once fetched in beforeSwap, same value used in afterSwap. registryUpdateTokenSettings requires admin tx (separate call). Reentrancy guard prevents mid-swap re-entry.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: H8: Reentrancy through token transfer callback hits different facet in diamond
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: AMMModule uses transient reentrancy guard (_enterAMM/_exitAMM). ENTERED bit stays set during entire operation. Any callback into any facet would hit the same transient guard and revert.

theft_theses.thesis: Pool type lies about amountOut to extract more tokens than moved
Handler receives wrong token pair and swaps different tokens
Hook inflates fee to drain more than amountIn from every swap
Stale transient storage causes wrong price check in direct swap
Pool type addLiquidity overreports amounts, LP gets free shares
Pool ID hash collision between two pool types
Registry settings change mid-swap enables inconsistent enforcement
Token callback reentrancy into diamond corrupts shared storage
